chain.label: 300-hour torque check and inspection interval too long to catch impending failure
chain.trigger: The Bell 407 maintenance manual requires a torque check of the tail boom attachment hardware and a visual inspection of the tail boom attachment fittings every 300 hours.

chain.label: Upper-left tail boom attachment hardware separated and missing before the accident flight
chain.trigger: The upper-left tail boom attachment hardware, consisting of a bolt, washers, and a nut, was not present at the accident site and was not found... it is unknown at this time when or why the bolt separated.

chain.label: Separated hardware and impending failure not detected at last torque check and visual inspection
chain.trigger: the most recent tail boom attachment hardware torque check and visual inspection of the attachment fittings was completed 114.2 hours before the accident occurred with no anomalies noted

caused_by.evidence: instances of improperly installed or fractured attachment hardware or fittings may not be detected within the existing 300-hour recurrent torque check and visual inspection interval
attachment hardware that is not installed properly, is cracked and/or is near an impending failure could exhibit a loss of installation torque and not pass a torque check

chain.label: Load redistributed to remaining three fittings, initiating fatigue cracking of the lower-left fitting
chain.trigger: The upper-left tail boom attachment bolt separated first, resulting in the redistribution of the load normally carried by the upper-left attachment fitting to the remaining three attachment fittings and the subsequent initiation of fatigue fractures on the lower-left attachment fitting.

caused_by.evidence: the upper-left tail boom attachment fitting has the highest tension loading of the four attachment fittings and is considered the most important of the four
it is possible that the fatigue crack grew over multiple takeoffs and landings

chain.label: Inflight separation of the tail boom at the attach point
chain.trigger: Examination of the tail boom revealed it separated from the fuselage at the tail boom attach point... the upper-right and lower-right attachment fittings had overload fractures.

caused_by.evidence: The lower-left fitting had multiple fatigue fractures, while the upper-right and lower-right attachment fittings had overload fractures.

chain.label: Uncontrolled spin to the right with descent
chain.trigger: about 30 minutes into the flight, the helicopter began an uncontrolled spin to the right... The helicopter continued to spin uncontrollably while it descended

caused_by.evidence: impacted terrain near Kalea, Hawaii, following an inflight separation of the tail boom

chain.label: Rough, uneven, lava-covered terrain below
chain.trigger: impacted an area of rough, uneven, lava-covered terrain

chain.label: Helicopter impacted terrain and sustained substantial damage
chain.trigger: The helicopter sustained substantial damage during the impact.

caused_by.evidence: The helicopter continued to spin uncontrollably while it descended and impacted an area of rough, uneven, lava-covered terrain.
impacted an area of rough, uneven, lava-covered terrain

chain.label: Three occupants seriously injured, three minor injuries
chain.trigger: The pilot and two passengers sustained serious injuries, and three passengers sustained minor injuries.

caused_by.evidence: The helicopter sustained substantial damage during the impact.
